-- Prueft Terminstatus und Zeitdauer fuer die Kostenlogik. Nur lesend.
WITH basis AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           CASE WHEN date_start IS NOT NULL AND date_end IS NOT NULL
                THEN round((extract(epoch FROM (date_end - date_start)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) END AS dauer_stunden
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv v
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Status ab 2023' AS bereich,
           coalesce(termin_status, '(leer)') AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('mit Buchung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen_gebucht > 0),
                  ' / ohne Buchung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen_gebucht = 0),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM basis
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Dauer produktiv',
           concat(dauer_stunden, ' Stunden'), count(*)::numeric,
           concat('mit Buchung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen_gebucht > 0),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2))
    FROM basis
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND dauer_stunden IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 3
    HAVING count(*) >= 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Zeitproblem',
           CASE WHEN date_start IS NULL THEN 'Start fehlt'
                WHEN date_end IS NULL THEN 'Ende fehlt'
                WHEN date_end <= date_start THEN 'Ende nicht nach Start'
                WHEN dauer_stunden > 12 THEN 'Dauer ueber 12 Stunden'
                ELSE 'sonstig' END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('mit Buchung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen_gebucht > 0),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2))
    FROM basis
    WHERE date_start IS NULL OR date_end IS NULL OR date_end <= date_start OR dauer_stunden > 12
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Status mit Buchung',
           coalesce(termin_status, '(leer)'), count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze_gebucht), ' / netto ', round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2))
    FROM basis
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND buchungen_gebucht > 0
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT 'S47' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;
